## Applications
- Detailed web page grid system: homepage, basic contents page, sub-pages
- Three-column layout: left column (local navigation from level 2+), content area (main), right column/toolbox
- Modules: Site-Utilities, Main navigation, Breadcrumbs, Introductory text, Image area, Footer navigation
- Right column: contextual links, popular pages; quick links (FAQs, newsletter, contact) placed last
- Country-level flexibility for module/banner sequencing in right column
